text: The Unique Tag must be at most 18 characters long
The Item Detail Name must be unique across the inventory
If the „Other‟ reason is selected, the user must enter an additional comment
The original CRM acquisition data must be kept, not overridden by the values entered here
The sale price must not override the original item price in the inventory
The system must be available during normal Construction Junction operating hours.
Access to the application by the Construction Junction staff must require user login.
Department‟s Unique Tag must be unique across the inventory
